item.title: Trump threatens Oman, Iran war as 60-day talks deadline passes
item.description: The U.S.-Iran negotiations to reopen the Strait of Hormuz have failed to yield an agreement before the 60-day window closed.

item.title: Actress Hayden Panettiere, known for 'Heroes' and 'Nashville,' dies at 36
Search ongoing for suspect in shooting of police officer
item.description: Mark Lee Jackson, 59, is wanted for attempted murder and has been at large since Friday. Police consider him armed and dangerous.
